description: Cluster 1 Part A — Pure UI/IA rehousing. NO new backend, NO new schema, NO Plan mode. Renames, route changes, tab moves, and a new Assignments page assembled from existing components (Marketplace IA pattern + existing playbook/mission list hooks). Plan mode and thread switcher are deferred to Part B. Source: docs/PRDS/AUTOMATOS-0.2/10-PRD-CLUSTER-1-WORK-LOOP.md.

userStories.title: Rename Workspace → Deliverables and Activity → Command Center in sidebar nav
userStories.description: As a user, I want the sidebar labels to reflect the new naming so the IA matches VISION.md before any tab changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Update sidebar nav labels: 'Workspace' → 'Deliverables', 'Activity' → 'Command Center'
Update icon if a better one fits Deliverables (gift/package style); Command Center keeps existing icon
Add new route /deliverables that renders the existing Workspace page content (alias)
Add new route /command-center that renders the existing Activity page content (alias)
Old routes /workspace and /activity continue working (do not delete yet — redirects come in US-018)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Do NOT modify the existing Workspace or Activity components in this story. Just route + nav label changes. Component renames happen later or via grep-and-replace once everything points at the new paths.

userStories.title: Add 'Created today' section to Deliverables page
userStories.description: As a user opening Deliverables in the morning, I want a featured row at the top showing what my crew produced today so I get an immediate emotional payoff.
acceptanceCriteria: New component frontend/components/deliverables/created-today.tsx
Renders horizontal card row at top of /deliverables page (above existing GalleryView)
Uses existing useDeliverables hook with date filter (created_date_range >= today_00:00 in workspace TZ — fall back to UTC if TZ not set)
Each card: file thumb (use existing FilePreview thumbnail logic), filename, file type badge, owning agent name, one-line caption like 'Auto: <agent> finished your <thing>'
Click card → opens existing DeliverablePreview slide-over
Empty state: 'Your crew hasn't shipped anything yet today. [Browse recent ↓]' (link scrolls to gallery below)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reuse useDeliverables — DO NOT create a new hook. Filter client-side if the hook's date filter doesn't support created_today natively.

userStories.title: Add tabs scaffold to Deliverables page
userStories.description: As a user, I want tabs [Outputs] [Blogs] [Templates] [Explorer] on Deliverables so I can switch between artifact types and pro-mode tooling.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace existing WorkspaceViewToggle (gallery/explorer/activity) with a 4-tab strip on /deliverables: Outputs, Blogs, Templates, Explorer
Outputs tab is default-selected; renders existing GalleryView (no changes to GalleryView itself)
Blogs/Templates tabs scaffold to placeholder content for now (filled in US-004 and US-006)
Explorer tab — clicking does NOT render content inside the tabbed layout. Instead, it navigates to /deliverables/explorer (full-page mode in US-007)
URL param ?tab=outputs|blogs|templates persists on refresh
Activity view from old Workspace is REMOVED (Command Center owns that)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Match Marketplace tab styling for visual consistency.

userStories.title: Move Blog tab from Activity to Deliverables
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Blog tab to live on Deliverables (where it belongs as a deliverable type) and to be removed from Activity/Command Center.
acceptanceCriteria: Move existing ActivityBlog component (frontend/components/activity/activity-blog.tsx) to frontend/components/deliverables/deliverables-blogs.tsx (rename + relocate)
Wire it into the Blogs tab on /deliverables (US-003 placeholder)
Remove Blog tab from Activity/Command Center page (TAB_DEFS in /app/activity/page.tsx)
All blog API calls (existing /api/blogs hooks) keep working — just relocated UI
If commit d9941e36d already started this move, VERIFY current state first and finish whatever remains
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: VERIFY first. The Explore agent reported that despite the commit, ActivityBlog is still rendered on the Activity page. Confirm current state before re-implementing.

userStories.title: Add SEO metadata panel + draft/publish toggle to Blogs
userStories.description: As a workspace admin reviewing an agent-generated blog, I want to edit SEO metadata (title, slug, cover URL, tags, meta description) and toggle Draft/Publish without leaving Deliverables.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog editor view (right slide-over preferred — match DeliverablePreview pattern) opens on blog card click
Editor view shows: rendered preview, SEO metadata panel with editable fields (title, slug, cover_url, tags, meta_description)
Save updates blog via existing blog API (PATCH /api/blogs/:id or whatever exists — search before adding new endpoint)
Draft/Publish toggle component on the editor view
Toggle switches blog.status between 'draft' and 'published' via existing blog API
On first publish, show confirmation modal: 'This will make your blog visible at <url>. Publish?'
Toggle role-gated: non-admins see toggle disabled with tooltip ('Workspace admin can publish')
Toast on success
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Search existing blog editor / metadata code before building. If most of this exists today as part of the blog widget or activity-blog flow, this story is mostly verification + filling gaps. DO NOT add a new endpoint if PATCH /api/blogs/:id already supports status updates.

userStories.title: Move Templates surface to Deliverables → Templates tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Templates surface (output template definitions) on Deliverables → Templates tab, alongside the deliverables they produce.
acceptanceCriteria: Search frontend for existing Templates surface (likely under /workspace/templates or /settings/templates or a marketplace tab)
Wire the existing component into the Templates tab on /deliverables (US-003 placeholder)
If templates currently render somewhere else on the platform, KEEP both surfaces working for one wave (don't delete the old one yet)
Templates list uses existing templates API/hook
Card grid: name, schema preview, last-updated, last-used count
Click card → existing template detail view (slide-over or inline)
Brand primitives ({{company.*}}) interpolation already works — verify, don't re-implement
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: If no Templates surface exists today, mark this story as 'placeholder' and ship an empty-state card pointing to where templates will come from. Do NOT build a templates editor — that's a separate PRD.

userStories.title: Explorer tab — viewport-full mode
userStories.description: As a power user clicking the Explorer tab, I want a viewport-full file system view (file tree + preview + terminal) so I can work directly with artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /deliverables/explorer renders the existing WorkspaceExplorer component (frontend/components/workspace/WorkspaceExplorer.tsx)
Layout: page sidebar + top header retained; main content area takes 100% remaining width
Deliverables tab strip is HIDDEN on the explorer route (it's a mode switch, not a tab)
Add 'Back to Deliverables' button in the explorer header that navigates to /deliverables?tab=outputs
ESC keybinding also returns to /deliverables
URL deep-linking works (?path=...) — existing WorkspaceExplorer already supports this
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: WorkspaceExplorer ALREADY exists with file tree + preview + terminal. This story is route + layout work, not building the explorer.

userStories.title: Add History tab to Command Center
userStories.description: As a user reviewing past runs, I want a History tab on Command Center showing completed Playbooks, Missions, Tasks, and scheduled cron firings in one filterable list.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 5th tab to /command-center: Summary · Board · Calendar · Feed · History (in this order)
Backend: search for existing run-history endpoints — useExecutionHistory hook exists, plus orchestration_runs (missions), recipe_executions (playbooks), board_tasks completions exist
If no unified runs view exists, create a small UNION query endpoint GET /api/runs/history that combines these sources (this is the ONE small backend addition Part A may need — keep it read-only)
Frontend: filter bar at top with chips [All] [Playbooks] [Missions] [Tasks] [Schedules], date range picker, agent multiselect, status filter [success/failed/partial/cancelled]
Table columns: When · Source · Name · Agent(s) · Status · Duration · Cost
Default sort: newest first; pagination 50/page
Row click → run-detail slide-over (use existing detail components — search for ExecutionDetail, MissionDetail, PlaybookRunDetail; pick the closest fit and reuse, do not consolidate in this PRD)
Empty states: with filters / without filters
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: If a unified runs view requires a new endpoint, scope it as read-only and reuse existing tables. DO NOT add new run-tracking columns.

userStories.title: Assignments page shell (Marketplace IA pattern)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a fresh Assignments page laid out Marketplace-style (featured area + tabs + recommended grid) so creating work is intuitive and matches the platform's other catalog pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace /assignments page main content with new shell that mirrors /marketplace IA
Top: page title 'Assignments' + subtitle 'Plan, schedule, and orchestrate work for your crew'
Featured area placeholder (cards in US-010)
Hero hint placeholder (logic in US-011)
Tabs row [Playbooks] [Missions] (content in US-012/US-013)
Recommended-for-you placeholder (logic in US-016)
Reuse existing FeaturedBanner and MarketplaceGrid layout/styles where possible (frontend/components/marketplace/) — copy patterns, don't import marketplace components directly into Assignments
URL ?tab=playbooks|missions persists
Old Assignments view replaced (preserve component file as -legacy if you need fallback during dev, then delete in cleanup)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Visual parity with Marketplace is the goal — non-technical users have already learned that pattern.

userStories.title: Assignments featured cards: Mission hero + Playbook + Plan + Task
userStories.description: As a user opening Assignments, I want clear create-cards for Mission (hero), Playbook, Plan, and Task so I can pick the right shape with explanatory copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Mission card: large, top-left of featured area. Copy: 'Big complex work. 6–9 agents, field memory, parallel reasoning.' Primary button [Start →] navigates to existing mission-create flow (whatever /missions/new or modal exists today)
Playbook card: medium. Copy: 'Routines. Multi-task, schedulable, triggerable, reusable.' Button [+ Playbook] navigates to existing playbook-create flow

Plan card: medium. Copy: 'Iterate with Auto first.' Button [+ Plan] navigates to /chat?mode=plan&from=assignments — Plan mode itself ships in Part B, but this deep-link still works (ChatModeBar already has Plan mode UI)
Task card: small. Copy: 'Quick single action.' Button [+ Task] opens existing CreateTaskDialog (frontend/components/board/create-task-dialog.tsx or similar)
Cards visually match Marketplace card styles
Each create flow tested manually — clicking each button reaches the expected destination
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: DO NOT build new create flows in this story. Wire to existing ones. If Mission has no existing 'create' page (today users may only create via Plan mode or chat), point to /chat?mode=mission as a temporary destination — Part B will replace.

userStories.title: Contextual hero hint copy on Assignments
userStories.description: As a user at any stage of workspace maturity, I want a one-line hint above the create-cards that's relevant to my current state so onboarding and growth-state both teach me what to do next.
acceptanceCriteria: Compute workspace state on page mount: count of playbooks (existing useWorkflowPlaybooks), count of missions (existing useMissions), recent failed runs in last 24h (use existing run history if available, else skip the failed-run rule)
Hint rules: 0 playbooks AND 0 missions → 'Not sure where to start? Plan it with Auto.'
1+ playbook AND 0 missions → 'Ready for something bigger? Try a Mission.'
1+ mission AND 1+ playbook → 'What's next? Browse the Marketplace.'
Recent failed run within 24h overrides above → 'Something not working? Re-plan it with Auto.'
Hint renders below page title, above featured cards, in muted styling
Recompute on page mount only — no live subscription
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Assignments Playbooks tab
userStories.description: As a user wanting to run an existing playbook, I want a card grid below the featured area showing my playbooks with quick actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab content: card grid (responsive 3–4 across) sourced from existing useWorkflowPlaybooks hook
Each card shows: name, owning agent(s), run count (from RecipeExecution count if available, else hide), last run timestamp, schedule indicator if scheduled
Card actions (icon buttons): [Run] [Edit] [Schedule] [Share]
Filter chips: [Mine] [Workspace] [Imported]
Empty state: 'No playbooks yet. [+ Plan one with Auto] [Browse Marketplace]'
Click card body → existing playbook detail view (whatever modal/page exists today)
[Run] button triggers existing run flow
If a Playbook list component already exists (e.g. on Activity → Missions tab? or marketplace?), REUSE it — don't duplicate cards
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Search frontend/components for existing playbook card components first.

userStories.title: Assignments Missions tab
userStories.description: As a user wanting to view or re-run missions, I want a card grid of past missions with status and quick re-run.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab content: card grid sourced from existing useMissions hook
Each card shows: goal/title, status badge (current state from OrchestrationRun.state), agents count, last run timestamp, cost
Card actions: [Run] (replan + relaunch via existing /api/missions endpoint) [Edit] [Share]
Filter chips: [Mine] [Workspace] [Active] [Completed]
Empty state: 'No missions yet. [+ Plan a Mission]'
Click card → existing mission detail view (likely MissionDetail or similar component)
If a MissionList component already exists on Activity page, MOVE it (or reuse it) here
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Existing MissionList component on Activity page is the obvious reuse target.

userStories.title: Quick Task modal triggered from + Task card
userStories.description: As a user clicking +Task, I want a tiny modal that lets me pick an agent and write a one-line instruction so quick tasks don't require leaving the page.
acceptanceCriteria: [+ Task] card click triggers existing CreateTaskDialog (or equivalent) — DO NOT build new
If existing dialog has more fields than needed, that's fine — keep it as-is
Created task lands on Command Center → Board → TODO/Inbox column via existing flow
Toast on creation: 'Task assigned to [AGENT]. View on Command Center → Board.' with deep-link button
Modal closes on submit or ESC (existing behaviour)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is wiring, not building. CreateTaskDialog exists.

userStories.title: Plan card deep-link wiring
userStories.description: As a user clicking +Plan, I want the page to navigate to Chat in Plan mode so I land on the existing ChatModeBar Plan toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: [+ Plan] card click navigates to /chat?mode=plan&from=assignments
Chat page reads mode=plan param and activates ChatModeBar Plan mode (this UI already exists per current ChatModeBar component)
Back-link from chat returns to /assignments
Plan mode actual functionality (system prompt, plan panel, save flows) is in Part B — this story just wires the entry point
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ChatModeBar already has Plan toggle. This story is purely the entry-point deep-link.

userStories.title: Recommended-for-you grid (v1: recency + run-count)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a 'Recommended for you' grid below the tabs on Assignments mixing my workspace items and marketplace items, so I have ideas for what to run next.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend endpoint GET /api/assignments/recommended (workspace-scoped). This is the second small backend addition Part A may need — keep it read-only.
v1 ranking: workspace playbooks/missions sorted by (run_count * 0.6 + recency_score * 0.4), plus top 4 marketplace items by global install count
Returns mixed list of cards (max 8 items: 4 workspace + 4 marketplace, marketplace items badged)
Frontend renders below tab content as 'Recommended for you' section
If workspace has 0 items, all 8 are marketplace items
Click marketplace card → /marketplace?id=X
Click workspace card → opens detail view (same as Playbooks/Missions tabs)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: v1 is intentionally simple. ML ranking is out of scope.

userStories.title: Remove Activity Blog tab + Workspace Activity view
userStories.description: As a user, I want the old surfaces I'm not using removed so the IA is clean.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove 'Blog' tab from Activity (now Command Center) TAB_DEFS — already moved to Deliverables in US-004
Remove 'Activity' view from Workspace (now Deliverables) — already absorbed by Command Center
WorkspaceViewToggle component can be deleted if unused after this
ActivityBlog component file can be deleted from /components/activity/ if its move in US-004 was complete
No broken imports — typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Cleanup story. Run after US-004 lands so the move is verified before delete.

/workspace/explorer → /deliverables/explorer
/workspace/templates → /deliverables?tab=templates (if templates were here)
/workspace/blog → /deliverables?tab=blogs
/activity → /command-center
/activity/blog → /deliverables?tab=blogs
/activity/board → /command-center?tab=board
Permanent (308) redirects — Next.js redirects in next.config

Manual smoke: each old URL resolves correctly
